in_marathi.name: Poornima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Poornima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pournima', meaning 'full moon'. This name represents the feminine energy of the moon and signifies completeness and perfection.

in_bengali.name: Poornima
